subject: feat(phase-2+4): PortScannerViewModel, PortScanner codebehind, Snap packaging
body:
feat(phase-2+4): PortScannerViewModel, PortScanner codebehind, Snap packaging

- PortScannerViewModel: async TCP scan with 50-worker semaphore, known-service
  name lookup, start/stop commands, ObservableCollection<PortScanResult>
- PortScannerDialog.axaml.cs: codebehind for port scanner dialog
- packaging/linux/snap/snapcraft.yaml: Snap manifest (core24, strict confinement)
  with network/home/Wayland/X11/audio plugs; dotnet plugin build

https://claude.ai/code/session_011wf1rnTGf2hrsHvAeV4PsL

triage.rationale: Targets Avalonia UI and Linux packaging (Snap), which are completely out-of-scope and incompatible with our WinForms/.NET 10 architecture.
